description.narrative: Insatsen - "Skills for Energy in Southern Africa" (SESA) är ett drygt treårigt program för att i samverkan med näringslivet utforma och genomföra utbildningar inom förnybar energiteknik och energiefektivisering, med International Labout Organization ILO och SADC-institutionen Kafue Gorge Regional Training Centre KGRTC.

The contribution - "Skills for Energy in Southern Africa” (SESA) intervention is a Public-Private Development Partnership (PPDP) that enables a transfer of technical skills from international and local energy companies to power technicians and managers in Southern Africa through International Labour Organization (ILO) and in partnership with SADC’s Kafue Gorge Regional Training Centre (KGRTC) in Zambia.

Skills for Energy in Southern Africa (SESA) intervention is a Public-Private Development Partnership (PPDP) that enables a transfer of technical skills from international and local energy companies to power engineers, technicians and managers in Southern Africa. Sidas agreement partner is the International Labour Organization (ILO), who is implementing the intervention in partnership with Kafue Gorge Regional Training Centre (KGRTC) in Zambia and Southern Africa Development Community's (SADC). The program spans over four years starting in 2021 hence being finalized in 2024, and has a total funding volume of 38.3 MSEK from the Strategy for Swedens regional development cooperation with Africa.
The focus is on contributing to SDG 7 on universal access to modern energy, by responding to the power industrys needs for skills development in the areas of renewable energy, energy efficiency and regional energy integration, but also to SDG 4 on skills and training, and SDG 8 on sustainable economic growth, productive employment and decent work.
Overall Objective Increase uptake of Renewable Energy (RE), Energy Efficiency (EE) and Regional Energy Integration (REI) interventions in Southern Africa, leading to a more sustainable and low-carbon energy mix.
Specific objectives (Outcomes) Outcome 1: More power engineers, technicians and managers in the SADC region have enhanced technical capacity to apply, manage and promote the latest RE, EE and REI technologies. Outcome 2: KGRTC has built its brand and standing as the regions Centre of Excellence for competitive skills training in RE, EE and REI technologies.

tag.narrative: 4.4 - By 2030, substantially increase the number of youth and adults who have relevant skills, including technical and vocational skills, for employment, decent jobs and entrepreneurship.

4.4 - Till 2030 väsentligen öka det antal ungdomar och vuxna som har relevanta färdigheter, däribland tekniska färdigheter och yrkeskunnande, för sysselsättning, anständigt arbete och entreprenörskap.
7.1 - By 2030, ensure universal access to affordable, reliable and modern energy services.
7.1 - Senast 2030 säkerställa allmän tillgång till ekonomiskt överkomliga, tillförlitliga och moderna energitjänster.
8.2 - Achieve higher levels of economic productivity through diversification, technological upgrading and innovation, including through a focus on high-value added and labour-intensive sectors.
8.2 - Uppnå högre ekonomisk produktivitet genom diversifiering, teknisk uppgradering och innovation, bland annat genom att fokusera på sektorer med högt förädlingsvärde och hög arbetsintensitet.
